title: Electric potential expression
description: Essential: Student provides the correct potential V(r) = V_a * ln(b/r) / ln(b/a) for a point near the filament.

title: Wave vector k_x derivation
description: Important: Student correctly relates the impulse from the electric field to the change in momentum and thus to k_x, arriving at k_x = (e V_a π) / (ħ v_z ln(b/a)).

title: Non-relativistic wavelength
description: Essential: Student correctly states λ = h / sqrt(2 m e V_0) from energy conservation, ignoring relativity.

title: Relativistic wavelength
description: Important: Student correctly derives or states the relativistic wavelength formula λ = h / sqrt(2 m e V_0 (1 + e V_0/(2 m c^2))).

title: Numerical k_x calculation
description: Essential: Student correctly substitutes given values into the k_x formula to obtain the numerical result (approx. 3.46e7 m⁻¹).

title: Fringe separation calculation
description: Important: Student correctly relates fringe separation to k_x (Δy = π / k_x) and computes its numerical value (approx. 9.07e-8 m).

title: Percentage error in wavelength
description: Important: Student correctly calculates both relativistic and non-relativistic wavelengths and finds the percentage error (approx. 2.4%).

title: Apparent slit separation
description: Important: Student correctly uses the double-slit interference formula to find d = λ(l+L) / Δy and computes its value (approx. 1.03e-4 m).

title: Sign or unit error
description: Pitfall: Student makes a sign error in the electric field or potential gradient, or uses incorrect units (e.g., forgetting ħ vs h).

title: Relativistic energy misuse
description: Pitfall: Student incorrectly applies the relativistic energy-momentum relation (e.g., using E = mc² + eV₀ without squaring for momentum).
